axis_conflict: Retrieved: 71 distinct small-molecule actives but best potency is only IC50 1240 nM (~1.2 uM, pChEMBL 5.91) from a crude 'Inhibition of rhoA expressed in E. coli BL21' readout (uncharacterised), and bioactivity is dominated by RhoC/RhoA-C CELL assays (top assay 29.9% measures RhoC, a different protein; 68% of activity is RhoC/RhoA-C mixed) -- so the actives count reads higher than the target-specific, characterised signal warrants; 0 approved and 0 clinical-stage small molecules; no approved biologic (intracellular). Computed: the orthosteric switch-I/II effector/RhoGEF groove is a shallow, pre-formed (non-cryptic) site (D=1.6 volume 120-273 A^3, druggability 0.001-0.169). The two axes AGREE that direct small-molecule engagement is poor; the conflict flagged here is that a naive reading of '71 actives' and 'the Ras family has a drug (KRAS)' could be mistaken for tractability, when both dissolve on inspection -- the actives are indirect/RhoC-contaminated and weak, and the KRAS precedent is a mutation-specific cryptic pocket absent in wild-type RhoA.

family_precedent._note: Ras small-GTPase superfamily (Pfam Ras, PF00071 by annotation, not retrieved here). Do not read a drugged family member as RhoA tractability (rule 9b). Numeric family aggregation not run: cross_references reliably hit the Paperclip statement timeout (rule 15, Kind A).

pocket_volume_a3._primary_note: primary_d1_6_a3 is the D=1.6 site volume for 6V6U (the highest-resolution structure and the Foldseek query). Across the 3 apo structures the reproducible D=1.6 site volume is 120.0-273.1 A^3 (5C4M 120.0, 6V6U 207.1, 1A2B 273.1). The pooled max of 1110.6 A^3 is a D=2.4 MERGE artifact (>1000 A^3, rule 4a): at D=2.4 the site merges with neighbouring cavities (533-1111 A^3). The 210/240 A^3 guide is RETRACTED (rule 4a) and this volume carries no verdict by threshold; it is reported as an absolute cavity measurement, and it is shallow.

pocket_druggability._comparability: NOT REPORTED as a pooled value. min/max are null because pooling druggability across the 3 structures is not a measurement (rule 4.0 clause 2 -- the score is min-max normalised inside each structure). The reportable form is tractability.site_pocket_rank.
pocket_druggability._per_structure_across_d: Within-structure D-sweep (D1.6 -> D2.4): 6V6U 0.169 -> 0.416; 5C4M 0.001 -> 0.748; 1A2B 0.01 -> 0.924. The reproducible D=1.6 values are 0.001-0.169 (all low); the high D=2.4 values are merge artifacts (volume > 1000 A^3, rule 4a) and are not the site's druggability.
pocket_druggability._false_negative_rate: Reported, never load-bearing, never compared across structures. fpocket druggability is a within-structure rank and reads low on holo pockets with a drug bound (e.g. JAK1 median 0.009 across nine approved drugs; EGFR 6LUD osimertinib 0.013). Here it is not carrying the verdict -- the negative verdict rests on the retrieved failed-effort axis and the shallow D=1.6 volume, not on this score.
pocket_druggability._do_not_max: site_signature_overlap (caller switch I/II residues) anchored the site; max_druggability_no_ligand_site (rule 4.0 banned) was NOT used.

site_pocket_rank._note: The switch-region site pocket at D=1.6: 6V6U rank 2 of 9 (prank 2); 1A2B rank 1 of 7 (prank 2); 5C4M rank 6 of 7 (prank 4). It is not consistently a top-ranked pocket across the ensemble.

ensemble_consensus_fraction._note: 3 structures x 2 clustering values = 6 measurements. pocket_scan does not emit a strong-hotspot consensus fraction, so fraction_with_strong_pocket and meets_consensus_criterion are null.

tractability.site_hypothesis_basis: Caller site_residues: RhoA switch I (res 28-40) + switch II (res 60-78), the effector/RhoGEF interface derived from mechanism_hypothesis=orthosteric. Matched by site_signature_overlap in all 3 apo structures. Not established via a holo ligand (none exists for RhoA).
tractability.site_centroid_to_ligand_note: No drug-like/holo ligand exists for RhoA, so there is no donor ligand centroid to measure against; the site was anchored by caller switch I/II residues, not by a transferred ligand. mdpocket ran (ok, 3 structures) and returned only site_from_density (persistence cavity, ligand_anchored=false), which was NOT used as the site (rule 4b).

cryptic_evidence.basis: site_signature_overlap located the switch I/II site in all 3 apo structures (6V6U,5C4M,1A2B); the orthosteric groove is pre-formed, not ligand-induced. The full apo/holo cryptic census (rule 5) could not be run: no drug-like holo of RhoA exists to pair against.
cryptic_evidence.definition: Vajda 2018: cryptic only if the site is absent in all, or nearly all, unbound structures. Here it is present in all 3 apo structures -> not cryptic.
cryptic_evidence.source: pocket_scan cryptic stage (not_run: 0 holo reference, 3 apo) + site_signature_overlap presence across the apo ensemble

cryptic_potency_prior.basis: Shallow, pre-formed PPI/effector groove on a small GTPase; 71 small-molecule actives plateaued at ~1.2 uM (best IC50 1240 nM) with no sub-uM direct binder -- consistent with a flat interface site.

pocket_vs_interface._note: Measured against RhoGEF/GAP complexes containing the partner. Overlap 0.5-0.875 at D=1.6 across the 3 structures against the LARG-RhoGEF interface (1XCG); also tested against 1TX4 (RhoGAP).

tractability.caveat: The negative verdict rests on the retrieved failed-effort axis (71 SM actives, best only ~1.2 uM from an uncharacterised/cell-contaminated readout, 0 approved/clinical SM) and the shallow, pre-formed D=1.6 site (120-273 A^3, druggability 0.001-0.169), NOT on the druggability score (rule 4.0: not load-bearing). At D=2.4 the site merges (volume up to 1110 A^3, druggability up to 0.924) -- a clustering merge artifact (rule 4a), not evidence of a druggable cavity. The site is present in all 3 apo structures (not cryptic), but no drug-like holo of RhoA exists, so the full apo/holo cryptic census could not be run.

checks_run: Do all reported actives trace to a single assay, lab or chemical series?
Do the drug-like co-crystals in RhoA entries bind RhoA or a partner?
Are RhoA's own small-molecule co-crystals specific leads or promiscuous fragment-screen hits?

findings: Bioactivity is dominated by RhoC/RhoA-C CELL assays: the top assay (29.9%) measures RhoC (P08134), and 2 of the next 3 (RhoA/C-mixed transcriptional readouts) push ~68% of activity off direct RhoA measurement.

The drug-like co-crystals in RhoA-containing entries bind a PARTNER, not RhoA: F9M/XQ3/XPW (460-655 Da) are TRPV4 channel modulators (8JVI/8JVJ/8FC7/8FC8/8FCB/8J1B/8J1F), RhoA present only as the bound partner.

RhoA's own SM co-crystals are weak, promiscuous fragment-screen hits on RhoA-RhoGEF complexes (KLU/Z3O/ZBH, 7G8U/7G91/7G9H); KLU (a chloroacetyl covalent fragment) also appears in unrelated creatine kinases (7TUN/9B16).

The scored orthosteric groove is present in all 3 apo structures (site_signature_overlap; not one crystal form) and is not a crystallisation additive -- but it merges at D=2.4 (volume->1110 A^3, druggability->0.924), a clustering artifact (rule 4a); the reproducible D=1.6 site is shallow (120-273 A^3, druggability 0.001-0.169).

No RhoA-direct small-molecule programme reached clinical development (0 clinical-stage, 0 approved): the failure is at discovery, not a terminated trial, so terminated_programs is empty (a finding, not a gap).

Family precedent does NOT transfer: the closest Foldseek neighbours (RhoC 2GCO, RhoB 6SGE, Rho-GAP/GEF/GDI complexes) carry no drug-like holo; the drugged member KRAS (sotorasib) exploits a mutation-specific G12C switch-II cryptic pocket absent in wild-type RhoA.

next_experiment.description: Run a mixed-solvent MD / bioemu ensemble on the RhoA switch I/II region and re-scan for a transient sub-pocket invisible to static fpocket, AND counter-screen the ~71 reported actives in a direct biophysical RhoA binding assay (SPR/ITC) to separate genuine RhoA binders from RhoC/RhoA-C cell-assay artifacts.
next_experiment.rationale: The computed site is shallow and pre-formed (not cryptic) and the retrieved potency is weak and dominated by RhoC/cell readouts -- both consistent with not_tractable. The two things that could overturn it are a cryptic sub-pocket that static geometry misses and a genuine sub-uM direct binder hidden in the cell-assay-contaminated set.
next_experiment.resolves: Whether the negative small-molecule verdict is real or an artifact of (a) static pocket geometry missing a cryptic site and (b) RhoC/cell-assay contamination masking a direct RhoA binder.

headline.title: Small-molecule tractability: P61586 (RHOA)
headline.plain_language: RhoA reads not tractable for a small molecule: 71 SM actives but best only ~1.2 uM from an uncharacterised/RhoC-contaminated readout, 0 approved and 0 clinical small molecules, and the orthosteric switch I/II groove is a shallow, pre-formed cavity (D=1.6 volume 120-273 A^3).

metrics.label: Distinct small-molecule actives
metrics.meaning: Distinct small molecules with a measured pChEMBL value (rule 1b/14); a compound count, not an assay count.

metrics.label: Best potency
metrics.meaning: Best measured small-molecule potency (IC50, pChEMBL 5.91). No sub-uM direct binder despite decades of effort.

metrics.label: Top-assay share (RhoC)
metrics.meaning: Share of bioactivity from the single largest assay, which measures RhoC (a different protein); ~68% of activity is RhoC/RhoA-C cell readouts (rule 6).

metrics.label: Approved small molecules
metrics.meaning: Approved small-molecule drugs acting directly on RhoA (drugs_by_accession=0, reconciled).

metrics.label: Clinical-stage small molecules
metrics.meaning: Small molecules that reached clinical development against RhoA (0 rows with max_phase>=1).

metrics.label: Drug-like holo structures on RhoA
metrics.meaning: PDB entries with an optimised drug-like SM inhibitor on RhoA at its functional site; the drug-like ligands in RhoA entries are partner-bound (TRPV4) or promiscuous fragment-screen hits.

metrics.label: Site volume at D=1.6
metrics.meaning: D=1.6 orthosteric switch-groove volume for 6V6U; shallow. Absolute quantity, no verdict by threshold (210/240 guide retracted, rule 4a).

metrics.label: Disorder fraction
metrics.meaning: Fraction of sequence predicted disordered (metapredict); RhoA is well-folded, so the shallow site is not a disorder artifact.

steps.label: Two-axis verdict
steps.method: Two independent axes reported separately and never averaged (rules 4/9/9b); the verdict summarises them.
steps.formula: not_tractable when retrieved SM effort is substantial-but-failed AND the functional site is shallow/non-cryptic; druggability is NOT load-bearing (rule 4.0), volume + retrieved carry it.

uncertainty.method: fpocket clustering sweep D {1.6,2.4} across a 3-structure apo ensemble; no Monte Carlo / probabilistic model.
limitations: Ranges are clustering/ensemble scenarios, not confidence intervals. Druggability is a within-structure rank and is never pooled or compared across structures (rule 4.0). D=2.4 values (volume up to 1110 A^3, druggability up to 0.924) are merge artifacts, rule 4a.

limitations.message: No drug-like holo of RhoA exists, so the full apo/holo cryptic census (rule 5) and max_backbone_ca_displacement could not be run. The site is present in all 3 apo structures (site_signature_overlap) -> classified not cryptic, but a cryptic sub-pocket invisible to static fpocket cannot be excluded without MD.

Pooled druggability min/max are null: pooling a within-structure-normalised score across 3 structures is not a measurement (rule 4.0). Reportable form is site_pocket_rank; per-structure D-sweep in _per_structure_across_d.
~68% of bioactivity is RhoC or RhoA/C-mixed CELL readouts (top assay 29.9% measures RhoC); the 71 actives and the headline potency are not clean direct-RhoA measurements.
Pfam and family-actives not retrieved: cross_references hit the Paperclip statement timeout (rule 15). The KRAS mutation-specific precedent is recorded qualitatively.
affinity, structure.cofold_control and pocket_neighbour_precedent.cofold_transfer are null: no predictor / cofolding model in this deployment (rule 13).
